Klee One.desc: A quiet hand, written with a pencil or pen, and meant for body text.
apart: One-loop a and g, the way most people write them
In ff, fi, fl, ffi and ffl, the letters are drawn as one shape
Klee One.madeShort: Made by Fontworks, a Japanese type foundry; on Google Fonts since 2021.
Klee One.background: By Fontworks. Added to Google Fonts in June 2021. Free, under the SIL Open Font Licence.
Klee One.weight: Regular loads here; the family also has SemiBold.
Klee One.letters: English and Western European accents, curly quotes and dashes. This copy is Latin only; the full font also has Japanese, Greek and Cyrillic.

Zen Kurenaido.desc: Ballpoint handwriting: the brush details of Japanese calligraphy are left out, leaving the bones of each letter.
apart: Small lower case, so its default size here is raised
The l ends in a little hook, which helps tell it from a capital I
The a has a hood, as in printed text; the g is one loop
Zen Kurenaido.madeShort: By Yoshimichi Ohira, one of the Zen Fonts; on Google Fonts since 2021.
Zen Kurenaido.background: By Yoshimichi Ohira, one of the Zen Fonts, a family of Japanese typefaces added to Google Fonts in October 2021. Free, under the SIL Open Font Licence.
Zen Kurenaido.letters: English and Western European accents, curly quotes and dashes. This copy is Latin only; the full font also has Japanese, Greek and Cyrillic.
